headerDisplay: Control Swidget ERV (Energy Recovery Ventilator) devices locally.

host.title: IP Address
host.description: Local IP address of the Swidget device

accessKey.title: Access Key
accessKey.description: Optional access key if set during device provisioning

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to poll the device for state updates

enableFan.title: Enable Fan Control
enableFan.description: Expose the fan speed control in HomeKit

enableLight.title: Enable Light Switch
enableLight.description: Expose the light switch in HomeKit (only if physically connected)

enableBoostSwitch.title: Enable Boost Switch
enableBoostSwitch.description: Expose the boost mode switch in HomeKit

enableCondensationSensor.title: Enable Condensation Leak Sensor
enableCondensationSensor.description: Expose condensation module status as a leak sensor
